name: Chest-supported dumbbell row

phases.name: row
phases.cue: Drive your elbows back, dumbbells to your ribs

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower until your arms are long

phases.name: reset
phases.cue: Chest on the pad, arms hanging straight down

formTips: Set the bench to about 30–45° and lie face down with your chest on the pad
Keep your toes on the floor and your chest on the pad for the whole set
Let the dumbbells hang straight down under your shoulders, palms facing in
Drive your elbows back past your body and pull the dumbbells towards your lower ribs
Lower slowly until your arms are long and your shoulder blades stretch apart
commonMistakes: Lifting your chest off the pad to heave the weight up
Shrugging your shoulders up to your ears
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides
Cutting the range short instead of letting the arms hang long
